record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo (Misdreavus 1 star, Mismagius 2 stars, both passive NONE) declare NIGHT_SHADE in this production reference. Shared strategy; only the star count and stats differ.
record.summary: Single target. Requests ceil(F x TARGET maxHP x (2 + casterAP/100)), F 0.125 / 0.165 / 0.25 / 0.35 (fallback 0.35), as TRUE damage with apBoost false: AP 0 doubles the fraction, AP 100 triples it (1 star, maxHP 1000, AP 100 requests 375). A downstream crit still applies; the target's defences are ignored. Shields absorb first and Protect, skydiving and magicBounce still block it (no reflection for TRUE). The returned value is unused; no universal HP-plus-shield accounting is claimed.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

declaredRaw.unit: fraction of target.maxHP, requested before the (2 + AP/100) factor

effects.scaling: requested = ceil(F x target.maxHP x (2 + casterAP/100)) with the TARGET's current maxHP and the caster's AP at the cast; at AP 0 this is ceil(2 F x maxHP). apBoost is false, so handleSpecialDamage adds no further AP term (executed: 1 star, maxHP 1000: 250 at AP 0, 375 at AP 100; 2 stars: 330 / 495; 3 stars 500; fallback 700; maxHP 333: 84; AP -100: 125). A cast crit still multiplies by critPower (250 -> 500, AP 100 + crit -> 750; Rocky Helmet does not reduce it for TRUE, executed).
effects.resolution: handleSpecialDamage returns 0 for a target with protect, skydiving or magicBounce (executed; the magicBounce reflection exists only for SPECIAL, so none for TRUE). Otherwise handleDamage runs: a dead or resurrecting target gives 0; an enraged attacker doubles the damage (executed: 500); the defence division is skipped for TRUE (SPE_DEF 100 still 250); ceil with minimum 1; the shield is consumed first (executed: shield 100 -> shield loss 100, HP loss 150; shield 1000 -> HP loss 0). The requested amount, the amount applied to defences and any HP or shield actually lost are different numbers; the returned value is not read by this strategy and no general HP-plus-shield accounting is claimed.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the caster's stars; the 3-star and 4-star fractions (0.25, 0.35, fallback 0.35) are declared in the tables but unused by the bound baseline classes (Misdreavus 1, Mismagius 2). maxPP 100 and range 3 for both.

record.positionalConditions: None read beyond needing a target (range 3 for both units).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast recomputes from the target's current maxHP.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared: fraction 0.125 (1 star) / 0.165 (2 stars) of the target's max HP. Requested = ceil(fraction x maxHP x (2 + AP/100)). Applied: TRUE damage with no defence division, at least 1, x2 for an enraged attacker, the crit multiplier if the cast crits, then the shield first. The description writes the fraction twice with the second marked AP-scaled; that is how the source's factor (2 + AP/100) reads, and nothing adds a second AP scaling (apBoost false).
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Attacker-side multipliers in handleDamage beyond the enraged doubling (electric / psychic field x1.2 and later modifiers) and what happens after the shield step (items, resurrection, Cover Band, Fossil) were not traced for this ability; consulted core-mechanics.md section A and the handleDamage TRUE branch only
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence): only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read
unresolved: Whether the factor (2 + AP/100) matches the intended design is not decided here; the English description (two terms, the second marked AP-scaled) agrees with how the code reads, and the code is what is recorded
Resurrection paths, Shiny Charm, Fossil and Cover Band branches of handleDamage were not enumerated for TRUE damage
No other unit sharing the identifier exists in the queue; units not listed are not covered

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (handleSpecialDamage, handleDamage) and the real NightShadeStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units with controlled callbacks (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, section CATCHUP_E4); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed (stand-in target, maxHP 1000): the ceil formula by stars and AP, apBoost false with TRUE type, the downstream crit, the ignored SPE_DEF, the enraged doubling, the Protect / magicBounce blocks, and the shield cases.
